summary: Design document for ExamCritic: a generalized, offline-first web tool that lets math teachers evaluate exam problems against a structured rubric system (100-point Quality Score). Covers 7 criteria across 3 levels of generalization (universal → math-specific → exam-specific), with presets for Πανελλαδικές, τριμηνιαίες, and homework. Includes difficulty calibration with U-shaped scoring, taxonomy integration, and a guided evaluation wizard UX.
